note: Google Map Field defines the google_map_field field type (map center/zoom/marker/infowindow stored per delta), two widgets (google_map_field_default, olmap_field), three formatters (google_map_field_default, google_map_field_embed, google_map_field_open_layers) and a global settings form (route gmap.field.settings at /admin/config/services/gmap-field-settings) that stores the Google Maps API key in the google_map_field.settings config object (keys google_map_field_auth_method, google_map_field_apikey, google_map_field_map_client_id). No plugin manager, no Drush, no custom permissions. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object and in creating a google_map_field field on Article.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module google_map_field, what is the machine name of the field type it provides, and which widgets and formatters does it ship for that field type?
evals.expected_output: Field type id: google_map_field. Widgets: google_map_field_default and olmap_field (OpenLayers). Formatters: google_map_field_default, google_map_field_embed (Embed place iframe), google_map_field_open_layers.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using google_map_field, where do I set the global Google Maps API key? Give the settings route/path and the config object and key that stores it.
evals.expected_output: Route gmap.field.settings at /admin/config/services/gmap-field-settings (permission administer site configuration). It writes to the google_map_field.settings config object, key google_map_field_apikey (with google_map_field_auth_method choosing API key vs API for Work, and google_map_field_map_client_id for Work).

evals.prompt: What data does a google_map_field field value store per item in Drupal? Name several of the stored columns/properties.
evals.expected_output: Each value stores name, lat, lon, zoom, type, width, height, marker, traffic, marker_icon, controls and infowindow. isEmpty() is based on lat being empty.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a Google Maps API key has already been configured for the google_map_field module. Inspect the live configuration and report the exact API key value that is set.
evals.expected_output: The key is gmf_probe_key_7g2x, stored in google_map_field.settings:google_map_field_apikey (drush cget google_map_field.settings google_map_field_apikey).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a field that uses the google_map_field module's map field type. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_gmf_known is a node field of type google_map_field on the Article bundle (drush field:info, or load FieldStorageConfig node.field_gmf_known and check getType()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a new field named field_gmf_task to the Article content type using the google_map_field module's map field type. Create the field storage and the field instance on node/article and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig node.field_gmf_task of type google_map_field plus a FieldConfig on the article bundle are created and saved.

evals.prompt: Configure the google_map_field module on this site to use the Google Maps API key 'AIzaGmfTaskKey123'. Persist it in the module's configuration so map fields authenticate with that key.
evals.expected_output: google_map_field.settings:google_map_field_apikey is set to AIzaGmfTaskKey123 (e.g. drush cset google_map_field.settings google_map_field_apikey 'AIzaGmfTaskKey123').
